title: Mixing: Out The Blue by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The 14th of 17 mixing sessions for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 11 September 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. On this day the song ‘Out The Blue’ was completed, after an initial mixing session on 4 September.

Mixing sessions for Mind Games ran from 15 August to 14 September 1973.
